text: To analyze the dynamic trends of mortality, incidence, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) of liver cancer attributable to alcohol use in China from 1992 to 2021, as well as the age, period, and cohort effects, so as to provide a basis for the prevention and control.
source_label: Trend of liver cancer attributable to alcohol use in China from 1992 to 2021: An age-period-cohort analysis study
